summary: The change adds persisted per-user, per-workspace favorites, collapsible and reorderable sidebar sections, and a toolbar for quick actions. Both earlier findings are fixed: the durable basic E2E now uses the toolbar's "New Markdown file" button, and favorites show "Loading…" until their data source loads. The temp tests check for any "Unavailable" flash on reload, the storage-failure branches, the section-shift boundaries, and the toolbar and reorder handlers without a reload. All runs pass and every changed line is covered, so the change is ready.
